title: Numbers and time
summary: Count to a million with the noun left singular (*iki kitap*), make ordinals (*birinji*, *5-nji*), tell the time (*sagat bäşde*, *bäşiň ýary*), give dates (*21-nji martda*), and say how old you are (*ýigrimi ýaşymda*) and what things cost in manat and teňňe.
canDo: Count and say numbers up to the thousands
Ask and tell the time, and say at what time things happen
Name the days of the week and say a date
Ask and say how old someone is, and what something costs
